@graph.text: Descent pedalling occupancy fits a sigmoid in grade whose midpoint s50 separates the rider populations disjointly — ultra-distance specialists stop pedalling on gentler ground than seasoned amateurs. An initial 9-of-9 result was withdrawn: it scored the constant outside its own ≥3% scope and leaked the flat intensity from the ride being predicted. Rescored honestly, 7 of 9.
